operational_bottlenecks: 58% of Sales & Marketing budget is spent acquiring low-ACV SMB customers ($4k ACV) that churn at 38% annually (LTV:CAC = 1.8, Payback = 29 months).
Unoptimized single-tenant GPU/cloud hosting and manual onboarding for SMB accounts depress Gross Margin to 64% (vs 75% SaaS benchmark).
Enterprise segment has outstanding unit economics (118% NDR, 5.4x LTV:CAC, 11-month payback) but is starved of AE quota capacity.
